dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler! Thanks for introducing me to this job.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: As we agreed, the future maintenance of this shrine will become my responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: As for my payment... ah, the provisional head priestess says that she'll think of something. I just need to take care of the shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Ooshima Junpei
dialogues.text: Hmm. Maybe I should try making a few wood carvings in my free time later.
